name: management-research-kb
description: Connect Obsidian, Zotero, local papers, and Codex for evidence-grounded research ideation and writing.

interface.shortDescription: Turn Obsidian and Zotero into a research workflow.
interface.longDescription: Indexes local papers and Zotero metadata, builds linked Obsidian knowledge notes, and orchestrates two evidence-aware Codex agents for research ideation, paper writing, and claim auditing across disciplines.
defaultPrompt: Build linked knowledge notes from my local literature folders.
Use my knowledge base to develop an evidence-grounded research idea.
Draft an evidence-grounded paper section from my local sources.
